subject: opendap connectivity for micro_aust and micro_usa now works for PC

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: opendap connectivity for micro_aust and micro_usa now works for PC
parts:
Dear NicheMapR users,

I just discovered the RnetCDF package which, unlike ncdf4, allows opendap connectivity on PC (the latter only allowed opendap for OSX and linux). So I've now updated the micro_usa and micro_aust functions to use RnetCDF to connect to the gridMET and AWAP data sets, respectively. I'm very pleased about this!

All the best,
Mike
